name: SummaryChart
tagline: Summary Chart turns a list of records — a Dataverse view, a sub-grid or a canvas collection — into a clear chart.
description: Summary Chart turns a list of records — a Dataverse view, a sub-grid or a canvas collection — into a clear chart. It groups the records by one column (for example Status, Department, Supplier or Created on) and shows how many there are, or adds up / averages a number column such as Amount.
features: Groups records by a category column (Choice, text, lookup, Yes/No or date by month/quarter/year)
Counts them or sums / averages a number column
Accessible data-table view and click-to-select outputs
